places.n: KCR Community Resources – Immigrant Services (654 Bernard Ave location)
places.hours_text: Monday - Friday 8:30 am - 4:30 pm (closed statutory holidays). Immigrant Services – Walk-Ins Accepted Mon – Fri, 8:30am – 12:00pm & 1:00pm – 4:30pm.
places.who: Depends on the program. Settlement & Integration (federally funded): Permanent Residents; Protected Persons; people selected by IRCC to become Permanent Residents; CUAET visa holders — visitors are not eligible. BC NSP (provincial): foreign workers, international students, refugee claimants and naturalized Canadian citizens. BC SAF Haven: refugee claimants and asylum seekers. LINC English classes: adults 18+ who are permanent residents, convention refugees, refugee claimants, naturalized citizens or open-work-permit holders. Resettlement Assistance Program (RAP): Government-Assisted Refugees destined for Kelowna.
places.languages: Services in English and French and a variety of languages including Spanish, Arabic, Farsi, Dari, Mandarin, Korean, Tagalog, Russian, Ukrainian, German among others.
places.cost: LINC classes and immigrant-services workshops are stated as free; translation/interpretation is a paid service (quote per job).
places.appointment: Walk-in Mon–Fri 8:30–12:00 and 1:00–4:30, or call ext. 1 for an appointment with a Settlement Worker. LINC: book a registration appointment with the LINC Coordinator (250-763-8008 ext. 217); a placement test is part of registration.
places.note_en: KCR's second Immigrant Services address on Bernard Ave. Free help settling in, English (LINC) classes, and support for refugee claimants, workers and students — call 250-763-8008 ext. 1 to check which office to go to.
places.note_zh: KCR 移民服务在 Bernard 大道的第二个地址。提供免费安置帮助、LINC 英语课，并为难民申请人、工签持有人和学生提供支持——去之前先打 250-763-8008 转 1，问清楚该去哪个办公室。
places.verify_notes: KCR's contact page lists BOTH 618 and 654 Bernard Ave as 'Immigrant Services' (phone ext. 1) but does not say which programs are at which address; 618 is already on file. Program eligibility above comes from kcr.ca program pages (settlement-integration-services, bc-nsp-saf-havn, linc-english-program, resettlement-assistance-programrap) and can also be merged into the existing 618 record. LINC classes: 90 minutes, five days a week, sessions 9:00–10:30, 11:00–12:30, 1:00–2:30, 3:00–4:30; Pre-CLB to CLB 6; classroom location not stated. Documents to bring not stated. The LINC class formerly run by Ki-Low-Na Friendship Society has been transferred to KCR (kfs.bc.ca).

places.n: KCR Community Resources – Free Tax Clinic (CVITP)
places.hours_text: Operating months: March–June; September–December. Drop-off service: 9:00 AM–12:00 PM, 1:00 PM–4:00 PM, Monday–Friday. In-person appointments: March and April only (book via receptionist). Turn-around time for drop-off: 4–8 weeks.
places.who: People with a modest income and a simple tax situation, including low-income families, newcomers, seniors and persons with disabilities; not for people with self-employment, rental or investment income. CRA's suggested income limits (clinics may adjust): 1 person $40,000; 2 people $55,000; 3 people $60,000; 4 people $65,000; 5 people $70,000; more than 5: $70,000 plus $5,000 per extra person.
places.appointment: Drop-off (Mon–Fri) or virtual appointment; in-person appointments only in March and April.
places.bring: KCR's completed intake form and checklist (download from the page). CRA's list: valid government-issued photo ID; SIN or temporary SIN; tax slips; receipts; previous Notice of Assessment when possible.
places.note_en: Trained volunteers do your tax return for free and in confidence if your income is modest and your taxes are simple. You can drop off your papers on weekdays; it takes 4–8 weeks. The clinic closes over the summer, so call to check it has reopened.
places.note_zh: 收入不高、报税情况简单的人可以请培训过的志愿者免费、保密地帮你报税。工作日可以把材料送过来（代办），大约 4–8 周完成。夏季停办，去之前请打电话确认是否已经恢复。
places.verify_notes: Same building as KCR's main office (620 Leon Ave). Not shown in CRA's online clinic directory search for KELOWNA on 2026-10-03 (only COUC and Rotary clinics appeared), although KCR's page says it runs September–December. Languages not stated. Email incometax@kcr.ca. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: KCR Community Resources – Career Paths for Skilled Immigrants
places.hours_text: Monday - Friday 8:30 am - 4:30 pm (KCR office hours, all locations; closed statutory holidays).
places.who: Must meet ALL: lives in the Thompson Okanagan or Kootenays; became a Permanent Resident in the last 10 years and is still a PR; unemployed or underemployed; wants to return to their pre-landing profession; at least 1 year pre-arrival experience in a regulated profession or 2 years in an unregulated profession (1 year if 30 or younger); intermediate to advanced English.
places.languages: Services available in English and French.
places.appointment: Fill in the online Eligibility Assessment Form, or call/email (careerpaths@kcr.ca) to book with a Case Manager.
places.note_en: Free one-on-one coaching for permanent residents who want to get back into the career they had before coming to Canada, including help with licensing, training funds, mentoring and work experience.
places.note_zh: 为永久居民提供的免费一对一就业辅导，帮助你回到来加拿大前的专业领域，包括执照认证、培训资助、导师和工作经验等。
places.verify_notes: Same building as the KCR tax clinic (620 Leon Ave, Employment Services on the 1st floor per KCR contact page). Not for temporary residents (PR only).

places.n: Okanagan College – English Language Studies (Kelowna campus)
places.hours_text: Arts and Science office: Monday - Friday: 8:30-4:30. Classes are 20 hours per week; classes begin in January, May, July and September.
places.who: Adults 18 or older (or turning 18 in the first semester). Tuition is free for permanent residents, protected persons and Canadian citizens. Domestic students must take Okanagan College's in-person English language assessment (OCELA).
places.cost: Free tuition for permanent residents, protected persons and Canadian citizens; student fees and textbook costs apply (grants available).
places.appointment: Submit the 'Get started' form on the page; staff contact you to schedule a free assessment appointment.
places.note_en: Full-time college English classes (English Language Certificate and English for Academic Purposes) that can lead into college programs. Free tuition if you are a permanent resident, protected person or citizen.
places.note_zh: 学院的全日制英语课程（英语语言证书和学术英语），可以衔接学院的专业课程。永久居民、受保护人士和公民免学费。
places.verify_notes: Address/phone are the Arts and Science office (C245 Science Building, 1000 KLO Road) listed on the program page; classroom location not stated. Required documents not stated on the current page (an older directory says PR/refugee/citizenship documents are required). Temporary residents are not covered by the free-tuition statement.

places.n: Okanagan College – International Education (Kelowna campus)
places.hours_text: Monday - Friday: 8:30-4:30; Saturday and Sunday closed.
places.who: Okanagan College international students.
places.appointment: Contact by phone or email; immigration advising: intedimmigration@okanagan.bc.ca, 250-762-5445 ext. 4914.
places.note_en: Help for Okanagan College international students: certified immigration advisors (study permit extensions, post-graduation work permits) and help settling into life in Canada (cultural liaisons are based at the Penticton and Vernon campuses and answer by email).
places.note_zh: 为 Okanagan 学院国际学生服务：有持证移民顾问（学签延期、毕业工签等），也帮助你适应加拿大生活（文化联络员在 Penticton 和 Vernon 校区，可发邮件联系）。
places.verify_notes: Only for OC students. Cost not stated. General office email on page: askoc@okanagan.bc.ca.

places.n: UBC Okanagan – Global Engagement Office (International Student Advising)
places.hours_text: Office hours: Monday – Friday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm PT; closed on university-observed holidays and 12 pm to 1 pm daily. In-person drop-in advising: Monday – Thursday 9 am to 11 am and 1 pm to 3 pm PT; Friday 1 pm to 3 pm PT.
places.who: UBC Okanagan international students.
places.appointment: Drop in at the Global Engagement Office front desk (UNC 227) during advising hours, or book virtual (Zoom) advising.
places.note_en: UBCO's office for international students: immigration advising, health insurance and help settling in.
places.note_zh: UBCO 国际学生办公室：提供移民咨询、医疗保险和安顿适应方面的帮助。
places.verify_notes: Phone is the UBCO campus main line from the page footer (no direct office number published); email ubco.global@ubc.ca. Cost not stated.

places.n: Project Literacy Central Okanagan – Free English Tutoring
places.hours_text: Monday 9am – 7pm; Tuesday 9am – 5pm; Wednesday 9am – 7pm; Thursday 9am to 5pm; Friday 9am to 12pm.
places.who: Adults 19 or older. Working Holiday Visa and Tourist Visa holders do not qualify for English learning services. Canadians born here are also welcome.
places.languages: Tutoring is in English; the organisation says it supports learners from 27 different language groups.
places.appointment: Apply online as a Learner; an English assessment interview is booked (can take 1–3 weeks), then you are matched with a volunteer tutor.
places.note_en: A free one-to-one volunteer English tutor for adults 19+, for work, school, CELPIP, the citizenship test or the driver's licence test. Lessons are usually 1–2 hours a week, on 1–2 days, for up to 2 years. Working Holiday and visitor visa holders do not qualify.
places.note_zh: 为 19 岁以上的成年人免费配一对一志愿英语辅导老师，可以针对工作、学习、CELPIP 考试、入籍考试或驾照笔试来学。一般每周共 1–2 小时、分 1–2 天，最长 2 年。持打工度假签证或访客签证的人不能参加。
places.verify_notes: Waiting time for assessment 1–3 weeks per learner page. Children not allowed at lessons. Also runs 'Low-Literacy Support for newcomers' (three 12-week sessions a year) with KCR. FAQ calls the location 'downtown Kelowna'; Leckie Rd is in Midtown (area set dt). Old directories list 1635 Bertram St — superseded. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Evangel Church – Free ESL Classes
places.hours_text: Classes are on: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday 9am to 11:30am (No class on statutory holidays). Fall semester September 14 – December 9, 2026; 2027 semester January 4 – May 19, 2027 (spring break March 15 – 25).
places.who: Adult English learners at three levels: Low Beginner, High Beginner, Intermediate. Immigration-status requirements not stated.
places.appointment: Fall 2026 classes are full — email esl@evangelkelowna.com to join the waitlist (priority to returning students; full-time attendance required; missing 4 classes loses your spot).
places.note_en: Free church-run English classes three mornings a week, covering speaking, listening, reading, writing and Canadian culture. No childcare.
places.note_zh: 教会开办的免费英语班，每周三个上午，教听说读写和加拿大文化。不提供托儿。
places.verify_notes: Childcare no longer available (stated on page). Faith requirement not stated on the current page.

places.n: English Corner – Kelowna Downtown Library (free English conversation)
places.hours_text: Wednesdays 6:30 PM - 8:00 PM (UBC Innovation Library room).
places.who: Adults with beginner to intermediate English; everyone welcome.
places.appointment: Drop-in (no registration needed).
places.note_en: A weekly English conversation group for beginner to intermediate learners, Wednesdays 6:30–8 p.m., at the downtown library.
places.note_zh: 每周一次的英语会话小组，适合初级到中级水平，每周三晚 6:30–8:00，在市中心图书馆。
places.verify_notes: Same address as the existing 'Okanagan Regional Library – Kelowna Downtown' record — could be merged as a program note on that library. Run by volunteers with the Colibri Learning Foundation (englishcorner.ca). Schedule confirmed on ORL's event calendar for Oct 2026. Library opening hours: Mon–Thu 10–8, Fri 10–5:30, Sat 10–5, Sun 11–4.

places.n: English Corner – Kelowna Mission Library (free English conversation)
places.hours_text: Tuesdays 6:30 PM - 7:45 PM (Adult Area).
places.who: Beginner to intermediate English speakers (adults).
places.appointment: Drop-in.
places.note_en: A friendly weekly English conversation group at the Mission library. Practise speaking and meet new people.
places.note_zh: Mission 图书馆每周一次的英语会话小组，气氛轻松，可以练口语、交朋友。
places.verify_notes: Same address as the existing 'Okanagan Regional Library – Kelowna Mission' record — could be merged as a program note.

places.n: English Corner – Kelowna Rutland Library (free English conversation)
places.hours_text: Tuesdays 10:30 AM - 11:30 AM (Group Study Room).
places.who: People with beginner to intermediate English skills; everyone welcome.
places.appointment: Drop-in.
places.note_en: A weekly drop-in English conversation group at the Rutland library in Plaza 33 mall.
places.note_zh: Rutland 图书馆（Plaza 33 商场内）每周一次、随到随参加的英语会话小组。
places.verify_notes: CONFLICT: englishcorner.ca lists Rutland as Tuesdays 6:30–7:45 pm; ORL's own event calendar (Oct–Dec 2026) shows Tuesdays 10:30–11:30 am — ORL used. Same address as the existing ORL Rutland library record.

places.n: English Corner – West Kelowna Library (free English conversation)
places.hours_text: Saturdays 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM (Gathering Circle); Tuesdays 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM.
places.who: Those with beginner to intermediate English language skills; everyone welcome.
places.appointment: Drop-in; questions to westkelownaenglishcorner@gmail.com.
places.note_en: Free English conversation groups twice a week at the West Kelowna library.
places.note_zh: West Kelowna 图书馆每周两次免费英语会话小组。
places.verify_notes: Phone is the library branch (from orl.bc.ca); englishcorner.ca also lists a facilitator number 905-510-8507. Same address as the existing ORL West Kelowna library record.

places.n: OCCA Communities Association (formerly Okanagan Chinese Canadian Association)
places.who: Newcomers, immigrants, youth and seniors in the Central Okanagan; activities and services are open to the general public, usually for a fee; members (16+) join many activities free or at a discount. ESL classes are free for OCCA members.
places.languages: Helpline currently in English and Mandarin.
places.cost: Membership $10/person or $20/family per year. ESL free for members. Legal consultation with volunteer lawyers is free.
places.appointment: Helpline by phone/email or the online Newcomer Intake Form (appointments for complex issues). Legal consultation: online inquiry form, at OCCA's office or virtually. ESL: email info@occabc.ca to register.
places.note_en: A multicultural community association that helps newcomers: a Mandarin/English helpline, free legal advice from Access Pro Bono volunteer lawyers, ESL classes for members, tax-filing help and job programs.
places.note_zh: 多元文化社区协会（原奥肯那根华人协会），为刚到加拿大的人提供帮助：中英文求助热线、Access Pro Bono 志愿律师的免费法律咨询、会员免费英语班、报税协助和就业项目。
places.verify_notes: Office hours not published. ESL class schedule not shown in page text (break in July–August). Area: OpenStreetMap labels 1460 Inkar Rd as 'Pandosy'; assigned dt (near Capri/Gordon Dr) — confirm when geocoding. Okanagan Korean Culture & Knowledge Society (OKCK) lists the same address (no phone) — not added separately.

places.n: Centre culturel francophone de l'Okanagan (CCFO)
places.hours_text: Tue, Wed, Fri: 11AM - 5PM; Thu: 11AM - 6PM; Sat: 10AM - 3PM.
places.who: French-speaking newcomers to the Okanagan (francophones and francophiles); immigration-status rules not stated.
places.appointment: Contact the settlement agent (Alex) at bienvenue@leccfo.org; support in person or online, Tuesday to Saturday, in Kelowna, Penticton and Vernon.
places.note_en: The francophone cultural centre has a settlement agent for French-speaking newcomers (housing, health, schools, jobs, rights), plus English conversation workshops, TEF exam sessions and a French library.
places.note_zh: 法语文化中心有专门为讲法语的刚到加拿大的人服务的安置专员（住房、医疗、上学、找工作、权利等），还有英语会话工作坊、TEF 法语考试和法语图书馆。
places.verify_notes: Cost of settlement help not stated (membership gives library access). Postal code on site V1Y 6P5.

places.n: Okanagan Sikh Temple & Cultural Society (Gurdwara)
places.hours_text: Morning Nitnem 5:30 AM - 6:30 AM; Evening Rehras Sahib, kirtan & sukhaasan 6.30 PM - 8.00 PM; Door Closed By 8 PM.
places.who: The temple describes langar as upholding equality between all people regardless of background.
places.appointment: Walk-in during open hours.
places.note_en: A Sikh gurdwara and Punjabi community hub in Rutland. Its langar is a free community kitchen.
places.note_zh: 位于 Rutland 的锡克教谒师所，也是旁遮普社区的聚集地。这里的 langar（共享厨房）免费供餐。
places.verify_notes: OPTIONAL — the official site does not describe any newcomer-support program; included as a community hub with a free kitchen. Langar days/times not stated (sponsored langar seva on Sundays, Sangrands and Gurpurabs). Some directories give 1101 Rutland Rd N; official site says 1111. The other Kelowna gurdwara (Guru Amardas Darbar, Davie Rd) has no official site and conflicting addresses (220 vs 230 Davie Rd) — not included.

places.n: Ukrainian Orthodox Parish of Sts Peter & Paul
places.who: Refugees from Ukraine arriving in Kelowna (the parish's stated focus).
places.appointment: Call or email office@stspeterandpaulkelowna.com.
places.note_en: This parish says it helps welcome refugees from Ukraine to Kelowna by supporting their hosts, building welcoming relationships and helping them settle into the community.
places.note_zh: 这个乌克兰东正教堂区表示会帮助来到基隆拿的乌克兰难民：支持接待他们的家庭，建立友好关系，帮助他们融入社区。
places.verify_notes: Page content appears to date from the 2022 Ukrainian arrivals (CUAET); confirm the program is still active. Hours, languages and cost not published. Religious organisation — include at editor's discretion.

places.n: Ki-Low-Na Friendship Society
places.hours_text: Monday - Thursday: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM; Friday: 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
places.who: First Nation-informed programs for all peoples in all four stages of life: infants/children, youth, adults and Elders. Disability Tax Aid: people with Persons With Disability (PWD) designation, others with multiple barriers (PPMB), and low-income individuals.
places.cost: Disability Tax Aid tax preparation is free; other program costs not stated.
places.appointment: Disability Tax Aid: contact Reception to schedule an appointment.
places.note_en: Kelowna's Indigenous friendship centre, open to everyone: child and family programs, Elder services, mental-health supports, housing and outreach, and free tax preparation (up to 10 years back) for people on disability assistance or low income.
places.note_zh: 基隆拿的原住民友谊中心，对所有人开放：有儿童与家庭项目、长者服务、心理健康支持、住房与外展服务，还为领残障援助或低收入的人免费报税（最多可补报 10 年）。
places.verify_notes: Its former English/LINC program has been transferred to KCR Community Resources (kfs.bc.ca English Language Services page). Old directories list LINC at 620 Leon Ave under KFS — outdated.

places.n: Westbank First Nation – Government Office (Lindley Building)
places.who: WFN Members and non-Member residents of WFN lands: 'Many programs & services are offered to both Member and non-Member community residents; if you're unsure, please ask!'
places.appointment: Call or email mail@wfn.ca first.
places.note_en: Main office of Westbank First Nation, a self-governing First Nation whose lands include many non-Member residents. General inquiries go here; WFN Taxation is 250-769-2400.
places.note_zh: 西岸原住民（Westbank First Nation）的主要政府办公室。WFN 是自治的原住民族，其土地上也住着很多非成员居民。一般问题找这里；WFN 税务部门电话 250-769-2400。
places.verify_notes: Contact page: 'Lindley Building (Government) 515 Hwy 97, Westbank, BC, V1Z 3J2'; Office of Chief & Council at #301 (third floor); site footer says '101-515 Hwy 97'. On WFN reserve land (mailing 'Westbank, BC'), not part of the City of West Kelowna — locality set to West Kelowna for map grouping. Office hours not on official site (211 BC says Mon–Fri 8:30–4:30).

places.n: Westbank First Nation – Community Services & Health and Wellness (Quail Lane)
places.hours_text: Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. (as listed for counselling, home care and other recurring health programs).
places.who: Health & wellness services 'support the physical, mental, emotional and spiritual well-being & healing of all who reside on WFN Lands'; some programs are for WFN Members only (e.g., chronic disease management; the free tax clinic).
places.appointment: Nurses are by appointment only — call 250-768-0227 ext. 2; counselling appointments recommended.
places.note_en: WFN's community services building: health and wellness programs such as counselling, home care and nursing for people living on WFN lands, plus Membership Services.
places.note_zh: WFN 的社区服务大楼：为住在 WFN 土地上的居民提供健康项目，如心理咨询、居家护理和护士服务，还有成员服务处。
places.verify_notes: CRA's tax-clinic directory lists 'Tax Return for WFN members only' here (by appointment, drop-off or walk-in, Mon–Fri 8:00–4:30, 2026-03-15 to 2026-10-30, English/French, clientele Indigenous). Which programs are open to non-Members must be asked. Cost not stated.

places.n: Okanagan Nation Alliance – Main Office
places.hours_text: Our offices are open Monday to Friday from 8:30 am – 4:30 pm, excluding statutory holidays.
places.appointment: Call first (toll-free 1-866-662-9609).
places.note_en: Main office of the Okanagan Nation Alliance, which works for the Syilx Okanagan Nation — the people on whose unceded territory Kelowna stands. Contact for general inquiries about Syilx programs, culture and events.
places.note_zh: 奥肯那根族联盟（Okanagan Nation Alliance）总部，为 Syilx 奥肯那根族服务——基隆拿就位于他们未割让的传统土地上。可咨询 Syilx 相关项目、文化和活动。
places.verify_notes: Program eligibility not stated on the contact page; most ONA programs are designed for Syilx communities, so this is mainly a learning/awareness listing for newcomers. Mailing city 'Westbank, BC V4T 3L7'; locality set to West Kelowna.

places.n: Central Okanagan United Church – Thursday Free Tax Clinic (CVITP)
places.hours_text: Income Tax Clinic Thursday at 9am - Opening days vary outside tax season. Please call to confirm.
places.who: General public with a modest income and a simple tax situation (CVITP).
places.appointment: Walk-in; first come, first served.
places.bring: CRA's list: valid government-issued photo ID; SIN or temporary SIN; tax slips; receipts; previous Notice of Assessment when possible.
places.note_en: The church runs an income tax clinic on Thursdays at 9 a.m.; outside tax season the days vary, so call 250-762-3311 before going. Parking is behind the church, reached by the alley off Richter Street.
places.note_zh: 教堂每周四上午 9 点有报税服务；报税季以外的日子不固定，去之前请先打 250-762-3311 确认。停车场在教堂后面，从 Richter 街旁的小巷进入。
places.verify_notes: Source is the CRA free-tax-clinic directory (search BC > KELOWNA, clinic 'COUC Thursday Mornings', retrieved 2026-10-03): wheelchair accessible; 1 volunteer. The church's own tax-clinic page now returns 'page not found'; an earlier version said government ID is required and to call ahead because volunteer availability changes. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Rotary Club of Kelowna Ogopogo – Free Tax Clinic at St Michael's Cathedral
places.hours_text: 1st Friday of each month from 09:00 AM - 12:00 PM, 2026-05-01 to 2026-12-04 (appointments required). Spring session: every Friday 9 AM–noon, March 6–April 24, 2026.
places.who: Individuals with modest incomes and simple tax situations, including seniors, low-income individuals and families, newcomers, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, students and people experiencing homelessness.
places.appointment: By appointment (also drop-off) — email taxclinic@rotaryogopogo.org. Walk-ins only in the spring session (appointments take priority).
places.bring: CRA's list: valid government-issued photo ID; SIN or temporary SIN; tax slips; receipts; previous Notice of Assessment when possible.
places.note_en: Free tax filing by Rotary volunteers for people with low incomes, at St Michael's Cathedral (Richter Street at Sutherland Avenue). March to April: every Friday 9 a.m. to noon, walk-ins welcome. May to December: the first Friday of each month, 9 a.m. to noon, by appointment only — book by email.
places.note_zh: 扶轮社志愿者为低收入人士免费报税，地点在 St Michael's 大教堂（Richter 街与 Sutherland 大道路口）。3 月至 4 月：每周五上午 9 点至中午，可直接去；5 月至 12 月：每月第一个周五上午 9 点至中午，只接受预约，需发邮件预约。
places.verify_notes: No phone published (booking by email only). Address: CRA directory and the cathedral's own site (stmichaelscathedral.ca) say 608 Sutherland Ave; a Rotary calendar item says '650 Sutherland Ave' and 10:00 a.m. — 608 used. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Kelowna's Gospel Mission – Leon Shelter (men)
places.who: Men; 'for those trying to maintain sobriety while living in shelter'.
places.appointment: Call first.
places.note_en: Emergency shelter with 60 beds for men who are trying to stay sober while in shelter, plus showers, laundry, hygiene supplies and three hot meals a day. Call ahead to ask about a bed.

places.verify_notes: Same address as the existing 'KGM Community Dental' record. Hours/intake times, age limit and cost not on the official page (211 BC/CIOC say staffed 24/7, ages 19+). places.n: Kelowna's Gospel Mission – Bay Ave Community Shelter
places.who: Co-ed (all genders).

places.note_en: A co-ed shelter run by Kelowna's Gospel Mission, with space for meals, washrooms and case management services. Call ahead.
places.note_zh: Kelowna 福音会开办的男女都收的庇护所，提供用餐场所、洗手间和个案管理服务。请先打电话。

places.n: Cornerstone Shelter (John Howard Society of Okanagan & Kootenay)
places.hours_text: Open 24/7; once you have a bed, there is no set wake-up time.
places.who: Adults (19+) currently experiencing homelessness; minors are referred to youth shelters. Couples and people with pets are welcome.
places.appointment: Walk-in; new arrivals complete an intake.
places.note_en: 24-hour emergency shelter for adults 19+ with hot lunch and dinner, showers, laundry and clothing vouchers; staff help with housing searches. Couples and pets welcome. Under 19s are referred to youth shelters.
places.note_zh: 面向 19 岁以上成年人的 24 小时紧急庇护所，提供午餐和晚餐、淋浴、洗衣和衣物券；工作人员会帮你找房子。情侣和带宠物的人也可以入住。未满 19 岁的会被转介到青少年庇护所。
places.verify_notes: Email cornerstone@jhsok.ca. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Richter Street Shelter (Turning Points Collaborative Society)
places.hours_text: Operating Hours: 7 days a week, 24 hours a day. Registration: in person at 10am, 4pm and 9pm, first come, first serve.
places.who: Anyone over the age of 19 who is facing barriers to housing or experiencing homelessness; all-gender inclusive.
places.appointment: Walk-in registration at 10 am, 4 pm or 9 pm.
places.note_en: All-gender 24-hour shelter for adults 19+ (up to 48 people) with meals, showers, laundry, case planning and referrals. Register in person at 10 a.m., 4 p.m. or 9 p.m., first come, first served.
places.note_zh: 面向 19 岁以上成年人、不分性别的 24 小时庇护所（最多 48 人），提供餐食、淋浴、洗衣、个案规划和转介服务。每天上午 10 点、下午 4 点、晚上 9 点现场登记，先到先得。
places.verify_notes: Page still contains COVID-era wording; confirm current status. Area North End (dt). | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Bartley Court Shelter West Kelowna (Turning Points Collaborative Society)
places.hours_text: Operating hours: 7 days a week, 24 hours a day. Registration: in person between 2 pm and 4 pm Monday to Friday at 2515 Bartley Court, first come, first serve.
places.who: Anyone over the age of 19 who is facing barriers to housing or experiencing homelessness, and willing to follow house rules.
places.appointment: Walk-in registration Mon–Fri 2–4 pm at 2515 Bartley Court.
places.note_en: West Kelowna's 24-hour shelter for adults 19+ (42 spaces) with meals, showers, laundry, case planning and a resource room with job and rental postings. Register in person Monday to Friday, 2–4 p.m., at 2515 Bartley Court (next door), first come, first served.
places.note_zh: West Kelowna 面向 19 岁以上成年人的 24 小时庇护所（42 个位置），提供餐食、淋浴、洗衣、个案规划，还有张贴招工和租房信息的资源室。周一至周五下午 2 点至 4 点在隔壁 2515 Bartley Court 现场登记，先到先得。
places.verify_notes: Described as a temporary shelter ('short-term interim housing until a longer-term solution is in place') — check it is still open. Official postal code V1Z 2M7; 211 BC says V1Z 2M8. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: The Salvation Army – Community Services Rutland
places.hours_text: Monday 9 AM – 12 PM & 1 – 3 PM; Tuesday 1 PM – 3 PM; Wednesday 9 AM – 12 PM & 1 – 3 PM; Thursday 9 AM – 12 PM & 1 – 3 PM; Friday 9 AM – 12 PM & 1 – 3 PM; Saturday & Sunday Closed. Closed statutory holidays and holiday weekends.
places.appointment: Call for an appointment; you meet with a caseworker.
places.note_en: Caseworkers help with basic needs such as food, clothing and household items, referrals and finding your way around services, and Christmas gifts for children and youth. By appointment: call first.
places.note_zh: 个案工作者帮助解决基本生活需要，如食物、衣物和家居用品，提供转介和办事指引，圣诞节还为儿童和青少年送礼物。需要预约，请先打电话。
places.verify_notes: Hours differ between the site's pages: Location & Hours (used here) vs Community Assistance page ('Monday 9 AM to 3 PM; Tuesday 12:30 PM to 3 PM; Wed–Fri 9 AM to 3 PM'). Eligibility and cost not stated. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: The Salvation Army – Community Services Westbank
places.hours_text: Monday 9 AM – 3 PM; Tuesday 9 AM – 3 PM; Wednesday 9 AM – 3 PM; Thursday 12:30 PM – 3 PM; Friday 9 AM – 3 PM; Saturday & Sunday Closed. Closed statutory holidays and holiday weekends.
places.appointment: Call for an appointment; you meet with a caseworker.
places.note_en: West Kelowna caseworker office for help with food, clothing, household items, referrals and system navigation. By appointment: call first.
places.note_zh: West Kelowna 的个案工作办公室，帮助解决食物、衣物、家居用品、转介和办事指引等问题。需要预约，请先打电话。
places.verify_notes: Mailing city 'Westbank, BC V4T 3L7'. Eligibility and cost not stated. | Desk check 2026-10-04 (independent second reader, official pages): corrected note_en, note_zh.

places.n: Central Okanagan Food Bank – West Kelowna
places.hours_text: By Appointment Only: Tuesdays 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM; Wednesdays 4:30 PM – 7:30 PM; Thursdays 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM; Fridays (Tiny Bundles) 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM. Closed during BC Statutory Holidays.
places.who: Anyone needing help 'regardless of race, national or ethnic origin, citizenship, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, income source, age, and mental or physical ability'; you must show a current Kelowna or West Kelowna address.
places.appointment: By appointment only; register as a new client first.
places.bring: 1 piece of photo ID for each adult over 18 (BCID or driver's licence, student ID, passport, etc.); 1 piece of ID for each child (birth certificate, BC Care Card, passport, etc.); proof of current Kelowna or West Kelowna address (rental agreement, rent receipts, utility bills, etc.).
places.note_en: The food bank's West Kelowna branch. Citizenship does not matter, but you need ID for everyone in your household and proof of your address, and you must book an appointment.
places.note_zh: 食物银行的 West Kelowna 分点。不看国籍身份，但需要全家每人的证件和住址证明，并且必须预约。
places.verify_notes: Kelowna main location is already on file. Friday 'Tiny Bundles' slot is not explained on the page — confirm who it is for before describing it.

places.n: John Howard Society of Okanagan & Kootenay – Regional Office
places.appointment: Call or email info@jhsok.ca to be directed to the right program.
places.note_en: Non-profit offering housing (shelter, supportive and transitional housing), justice programs such as restorative justice and probation outreach, community programs and employment services.
places.note_zh: 非营利机构，提供住房服务（庇护所、支援性和过渡性住房）、司法相关项目（如修复式司法、缓刑外展）、社区项目和就业服务。

places.n: Employment Standards Branch – Kelowna office
places.hours_text: By phone: Monday through Friday, 7:30 am to 5 pm Pacific Time (office hours not stated).

places.n: Workers' Advisers Office – Kelowna
places.who: Workers and their families with WorkSafeBC (workers' compensation) issues.
places.note_en: If you were hurt at work and disagree with a WorkSafeBC decision, this government office gives free advice and sometimes represents you. It is independent from WorkSafeBC.
places.note_zh: 如果你工伤后不同意 WorkSafeBC 的决定，这个政府办公室可以免费提供建议，有时还会代表你申诉。它独立于 WorkSafeBC。
places.verify_notes: Address conflict: WAO office list (updated 2026-09-22) says 420-1726 Dolphin Ave; the Ministry of Labour office-locations page says 101-1726 Dolphin Ave — 420 used. No local phone published (fax 250-717-2010); hours not stated.

places.n: Kelowna Family Justice Centre
places.hours_text: In person: Monday virtual services only; Tuesday–Thursday 8:00 AM – 5:20 PM; Friday–Sunday closed. Virtual: Monday–Thursday 8:00 AM – 5:20 PM; Friday–Sunday closed. Hours are subject to change.
places.who: Parents and other family members dealing with separation or divorce.
places.appointment: If you do not have an appointment, call before you drop in.
places.note_en: Free government help with separation or divorce: parenting arrangements, guardianship, child and spousal support. Family justice counsellors are accredited mediators.
places.note_zh: 政府免费提供的分居或离婚帮助：子女抚养安排、监护权、子女和配偶抚养费等。家事司法顾问是认证调解员。
places.verify_notes: Toll-free 1-888-227-7734. Interpreter availability not stated.

places.hours_text: Services are available Monday-Friday, 9:00 am – 3:00 pm. Please check our Calendar for drop-in times and group activities.
places.who: Any parents, grandparents or caregivers in the Central Okanagan, or those who are moving to the Central Okanagan.
places.cost: Sessions or programs in the Parent Learning Place are free for participants.

places.verify_notes: Same address as the existing 'Pearson Road Elementary' record (hub is inside the school). Contact page still says to call to confirm access due to COVID-19 protocols. Coordinated by KCR.

places.n: YMCA Child Care Resource & Referral (CCRR) – Central Okanagan
places.hours_text: Monday: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Tuesday: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Wednesday: 9:00 a.m. – 8:00 p.m.; Thursday: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Friday: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; Saturday: 9:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
